verdicts.title: The relational complexity of linear groups acting on subspaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The relational complexity of a subgroup $G$ of $\mathrm{Sym}(Ω)$ is a measure of the way in which the orbits of $G$ on $Ω^k$ for various $k$ determine the original action of $G$. Very few precise values of relational complexity are known. verdicts.title: Property $R_\infty$ for some spherical and affine Artin-Tits groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $n\ge2$. In this note we give a short uniform proof of property $R_\infty$ for the Artin-Tits groups of spherical types $A_n$, $B_n$, $D_4$, $I_2(m)$ ($m\ge3$), their pure subgroups, and for the Artin-Tits groups of affine types $\widetilde A_{n-1}$ and $\widetilde C_n$. In particular, we provide an alternative proof of a recent result of Dekimpe, Gonçalves and Ocampo, who established property $R_{\infty}$ for pure Artin braid groups.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns property $R_\infty$ (twisted conjugacy classes) for Artin-Tits groups of spherical and affine types, which shares the word 'affine' but does not address conjugacy class orders in affine groups associated to Boolean functions or any link to communication complexity rank.
